 Sasson traded to Rangers from Canucks
 Vancouver receives fourth-round pick in 2029 Draft for forward
 © 
 Eakin Howard/Getty Images
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 20, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Max Sasson was traded to the New York Rangers by the Vancouver Canucks on Friday for a fourth-round pick in the 2029 NHL Draft.
 The 26-year-old is in the first season of a two-year, $2 million contract ($1 million average annual value) he signed with Vancouver on Dec. 15, 2025.
 An undrafted forward, Sasson has eight points (five goals, three assists) in 24 games this season, and 34 points (21 goals, 13 assists) in 119 NHL games, all with the Canucks.
 The Rangers (13-8-1) next play Sunday, when they host the Carolina Hurricanes (12:30 p.m. ET; HHN, CARNHL, NHLN, MSG, SN, TVAS).
